# Per world, country scope:
#   sr_cf_targetable_<key>  THIS may send its next fleet there: unclaimed, beyond the
#                           Moon only after its Mars Landing (sr_colonization_beyond_moon;
#                           lunar colonization design § 4), and under races only of a
#                           stage reached (the draw's candidates), under simple and full
#                           of stage 0 to 2, or with Deep Space Exploration or a colony
#                           held beyond the Moon (design § 3)
#   sr_cf_departs_<key>     a fleet can leave for it this month (its body's window, a
#                           paid launch the approach accepts, or a torch; Mercury and
#                           the Moon always)
#   sr_cf_eligible_<key>    the automatic pick may take it: targetable, a fleet slot free
#                           (not for the Moon, founded at once), departs, its cost
#                           covered, its transit within 180 months (design § 7);
#                           the goal alone first, the cheap test before the window's
#   sr_cf_beaten_<key>      a fleet already on its way lands no later than ours would
sr_cf_targetable_valles_marineris = {
	NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_valles_marineris }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ruined_valles_marineris }
	sr_colonization_beyond_moon = yes
	OR = {
		AND = { NOT = { sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes } sr_current_colonization_stage >= 1 }
		sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
	}
}
sr_cf_departs_valles_marineris = { sr_launch_target_cost_mars < sr_launch_never }
sr_cf_eligible_valles_marineris = {
	sr_cf_targetable_valles_marineris = yes
	sr_cf_has_free_slot = yes
	sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_goal_valles_marineris
	sr_cf_departs_valles_marineris = yes
	sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_valles_marineris
	sr_transit_months_mars <= sr_cf_horizon_months
}
sr_cf_beaten_valles_marineris = {
	has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_valles_marineris
	sr_cf_arrival_valles_marineris >= global_var:sr_site_inbound_first_valles_marineris
}

# The country's target (var:sr_cf_target, a world's index) is still targetable.
sr_cf_target_valid = {
	has_variable = sr_cf_target
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 1 sr_cf_targetable_valles_marineris = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 2 sr_cf_targetable_olympus_mons = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 3 sr_cf_targetable_hellas_planitia = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 4 sr_cf_targetable_utopia_planitia = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 5 sr_cf_targetable_arcadia_planitia = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 6 sr_cf_targetable_ceres = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 7 sr_cf_targetable_vesta = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 8 sr_cf_targetable_psyche = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 9 sr_cf_targetable_pallas = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 10 sr_cf_targetable_hygiea = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 11 sr_cf_targetable_io = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 12 sr_cf_targetable_europa = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 13 sr_cf_targetable_ganymede = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 14 sr_cf_targetable_callisto = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 15 sr_cf_targetable_himalia = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 16 sr_cf_targetable_amalthea = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 17 sr_cf_targetable_venus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 18 sr_cf_targetable_mercury = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 19 sr_cf_targetable_titan = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 20 sr_cf_targetable_enceladus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 21 sr_cf_targetable_rhea = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 22 sr_cf_targetable_mimas = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 23 sr_cf_targetable_iapetus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 24 sr_cf_targetable_titania = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 25 sr_cf_targetable_oberon = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 26 sr_cf_targetable_miranda = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 27 sr_cf_targetable_ariel = yes }

# The target can be launched for now: targetable, a fleet slot free (not for the
# Moon, founded at once; slots never fill under races only), departs, its cost covered.
sr_cf_target_ready = {
	has_variable = sr_cf_target
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 1 sr_cf_targetable_valles_marineris = yes sr_cf_has_free_slot = yes sr_cf_departs_valles_marineris = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_valles_marineris }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 2 sr_cf_targetable_olympus_mons = yes sr_cf_has_free_slot = yes sr_cf_departs_olympus_mons = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_olympus_mons }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 3 sr_cf_targetable_hellas_planitia = yes sr_cf_has_free_slot = yes sr_cf_departs_hellas_planitia = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_hellas_planitia }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 4 sr_cf_targetable_utopia_planitia = yes sr_cf_has_free_slot = yes sr_cf_departs_utopia_planitia = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_utopia_planitia }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 5 sr_cf_targetable_arcadia_planitia = yes sr_cf_has_free_slot = yes sr_cf_departs_arcadia_planitia = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_arcadia_planitia }

# The scripted GUI's world (scope:site) is on the Moon: the Target button's
# Mars Landing line holds for it without one (sr_colony_target_sgui).

	OR = {
		scope:site = 35
		scope:site = 36
		scope:site = 37
		scope:site = 38
		scope:site = 39
		scope:site = 40
	}
}

# ===== Modules (slice 4 design §§ 2, 5-6) =====
# Per world, country scope:
#   sr_mq_any_<key>               THIS has a module of it queued
#   sr_mod_can_queue_<type>_<key> THIS may queue one more: it holds the world, the
#                                 queue has a free place, the cap has room counting
#                                 queue and shipments, and a specialization's
#                                 founding choice is made
#   sr_mod_departs_<key>          a module can leave for it this month at no premium
# Any scope: sr_site_shipping_<key>, a module is on its way there.
sr_mq_any_valles_marineris = {
	OR = {
		has_variable = sr_mq_hab_valles_marineris
		has_variable = sr_mq_a_valles_marineris
		has_variable = sr_mq_b_valles_marineris
		has_variable = sr_mq_port_valles_marineris
		has_variable = sr_mq_def_valles_marineris
		has_variable = sr_mq_mine_valles_marineris
		has_variable = sr_mq_yard_valles_marineris
		has_variable = sr_mq_lab_valles_marineris
		has_variable = sr_mq_culture_valles_marineris
		has_variable = sr_mq_resort_valles_marineris
		has_variable = sr_mq_black_valles_marineris
		has_variable = sr_mq_train_valles_marineris
		has_variable = sr_mq_bunker_valles_marineris
		has_variable = sr_mq_foundry_valles_marineris
		has_variable = sr_mq_admin_valles_marineris
		has_variable = sr_mq_terra_valles_marineris
	}
}
sr_mod_can_queue_a_valles_marineris = {
	global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this
	sr_mq_has_room = yes
	has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris
	sr_mod_spec_used_valles_marineris < sr_mod_spec_budget
}
sr_mod_can_queue_b_valles_marineris = {
	global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this
	sr_mq_has_room = yes
	has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris
	sr_mod_spec_used_valles_marineris < sr_mod_spec_budget
}

	sr_site_terra_open_valles_marineris = yes
}
# Valles Marineris has terraforming still to do (any scope).
sr_site_terra_open_valles_marineris = { sr_site_terra_done_value_valles_marineris < sr_terra_full_months }
sr_mod_departs_valles_marineris = { sr_mod_departs = { BODY = mars } }
sr_site_shipping_valles_marineris = {
	OR = {
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_valles_marineris
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_valles_marineris
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_valles_marineris
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_valles_marineris
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_valles_marineris
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_valles_marineris
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_valles_marineris
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_valles_marineris
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_valles_marineris
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_valles_marineris
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_valles_marineris
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_valles_marineris
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_valles_marineris
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_valles_marineris
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_valles_marineris
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_terra_valles_marineris
	}
}

# THIS's module queue has a free place (of 20).
sr_mq_has_room = { NOT = { has_variable = sr_mq_20_site } }

# The queue scripted GUI's place (scope:op) holds an entry.
sr_mq_scope_place_filled = {
	OR = {
		AND = { scope:op = 1 has_variable = sr_mq_1_site }
		AND = { scope:op = 2 has_variable = sr_mq_2_site }
		AND = { scope:op = 3 has_variable = sr_mq_3_site }
		AND = { scope:op = 4 has_variable = sr_mq_4_site }
		AND = { scope:op = 5 has_variable = sr_mq_5_site }
		AND = { scope:op = 6 has_variable = sr_mq_6_site }
		AND = { scope:op = 7 has_variable = sr_mq_7_site }
		AND = { scope:op = 8 has_variable = sr_mq_8_site }
		AND = { scope:op = 9 has_variable = sr_mq_9_site }
		AND = { scope:op = 10 has_variable = sr_mq_10_site }

# sr_mod_can_queue_<type>_<key>'s conditions one by one, for the scripted GUI's
# is_valid, which gives each its own line (a tick or a cross); with
# sr_cf_scope_site_held and sr_mq_has_room they are the whole of it.
# The world's founding specialization is chosen.

		AND = { scope:site = 1 scope:op = 7 has_variable = sr_md_type_valles_marineris var:sr_md_type_valles_marineris = 7 }

# THIS holds a colony of at least MIN people (the life events).
sr_life_has_colony = {
	OR = {
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= this sr_site_pop_value_olympus_mons >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia ?= this sr_site_pop_value_hellas_planitia >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia ?= this sr_site_pop_value_utopia_planitia >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia ?= this sr_site_pop_value_arcadia_planitia >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres ?= this sr_site_pop_value_ceres >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_vesta ?= this sr_site_pop_value_vesta >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_psyche ?= this sr_site_pop_value_psyche >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pallas ?= this sr_site_pop_value_pallas >= $MIN$ }

		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_amalthea ?= this sr_site_pop_value_amalthea >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= this sr_site_pop_value_venus >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= this sr_site_pop_value_mercury >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_titan ?= this sr_site_pop_value_titan >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_enceladus ?= this sr_site_pop_value_enceladus >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_rhea ?= this sr_site_pop_value_rhea >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mimas ?= this sr_site_pop_value_mimas >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_iapetus ?= this sr_site_pop_value_iapetus >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_titania ?= this sr_site_pop_value_titania >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_oberon ?= this sr_site_pop_value_oberon >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_miranda ?= this sr_site_pop_value_miranda >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ariel ?= this sr_site_pop_value_ariel >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_triton ?= this sr_site_pop_value_triton >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_proteus ?= this sr_site_pop_value_proteus >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto ?= this sr_site_pop_value_pluto >= $MIN$ }

# Per world, country scope: THIS may receive the free colony's petition: it supplies
# it with full ties, can hold a colony, and has no petition open.
sr_free_may_petition_valles_marineris = {
	has_variable = sr_free_supply_valles_marineris
	sr_free_ties_value_valles_marineris >= sr_free_ties_full
	sr_site_can_hold = yes
	NOT = { has_variable = sr_petition_site }
}

# THIS's event world (VAR, a country variable holding its index) holds at least MIN
# people (space_race_events.93).
sr_site_var_people = {
	has_variable = $VAR$
	OR = {
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 1 sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 2 sr_site_pop_value_olympus_mons >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 3 sr_site_pop_value_hellas_planitia >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 4 sr_site_pop_value_utopia_planitia >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 5 sr_site_pop_value_arcadia_planitia >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 6 sr_site_pop_value_ceres >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 7 sr_site_pop_value_vesta >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 8 sr_site_pop_value_psyche >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 9 sr_site_pop_value_pallas >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 10 sr_site_pop_value_hygiea >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 11 sr_site_pop_value_io >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 12 sr_site_pop_value_europa >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 13 sr_site_pop_value_ganymede >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 14 sr_site_pop_value_callisto >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 15 sr_site_pop_value_himalia >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 16 sr_site_pop_value_amalthea >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 17 sr_site_pop_value_venus >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 18 sr_site_pop_value_mercury >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 19 sr_site_pop_value_titan >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 20 sr_site_pop_value_enceladus >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 21 sr_site_pop_value_rhea >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 22 sr_site_pop_value_mimas >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 23 sr_site_pop_value_iapetus >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 24 sr_site_pop_value_titania >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 25 sr_site_pop_value_oberon >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 26 sr_site_pop_value_miranda >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 27 sr_site_pop_value_ariel >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 28 sr_site_pop_value_triton >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 29 sr_site_pop_value_proteus >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 30 sr_site_pop_value_pluto >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 31 sr_site_pop_value_eris >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 32 sr_site_pop_value_makemake >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 33 sr_site_pop_value_haumea >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 34 sr_site_pop_value_sedna >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 35 sr_site_pop_value_shackleton >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 36 sr_site_pop_value_peary >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 37 sr_site_pop_value_tranquility >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 38 sr_site_pop_value_marius_hills >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 39 sr_site_pop_value_daedalus >= $MIN$ }
		AND = { var:$VAR$ = 40 sr_site_pop_value_imbrium >= $MIN$ }
	}
}

# The scripted GUIs' world (scope:site): a free colony; one THIS supplies.
sr_free_scope_site_free = {
	OR = {
		AND = { scope:site = 1 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_valles_marineris }
		AND = { scope:site = 2 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_olympus_mons }
		AND = { scope:site = 3 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_hellas_planitia }
		AND = { scope:site = 4 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_utopia_planitia }
		AND = { scope:site = 5 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_arcadia_planitia }
		AND = { scope:site = 6 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_ceres }
		AND = { scope:site = 7 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_vesta }
		AND = { scope:site = 8 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_psyche }
		AND = { scope:site = 9 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_pallas }
		AND = { scope:site = 10 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_hygiea }
		AND = { scope:site = 11 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_io }
		AND = { scope:site = 12 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_europa }
		AND = { scope:site = 13 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_ganymede }
		AND = { scope:site = 14 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_callisto }
		AND = { scope:site = 15 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_himalia }
		AND = { scope:site = 16 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_amalthea }
		AND = { scope:site = 17 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_venus }
		AND = { scope:site = 18 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_mercury }
		AND = { scope:site = 19 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_titan }
		AND = { scope:site = 20 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_enceladus }
		AND = { scope:site = 21 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_rhea }

		AND = { scope:site = 23 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_iapetus }

		AND = { scope:site = 36 has_global_variable = sr_site_free_peary }

		AND = { scope:site = 27 has_variable = sr_free_supply_ariel }
